zh.title: CSS 盒模型尺寸探索器
zh.subtitle: 相同的十個數字，兩種盒模型。理解宣告尺寸與實際占用空間。
zh.hint: 寬高 0–600；內距最多兩位小數；邊框為整數。接受前導零，不接受正負號、指數或單位。每欄最多 16 字元。
zh.valid: 兩個結果已由同一份輸入更新。
zh.dirty: 輸入已改變；請按「產生」。舊結果已移除。
zh.error: 請修正所有標示的欄位。
zh.defaultExample: 預設示例：比較兩種 sizing 的空間。
zh.native: 原生 CSS 預覽（實際尺寸，局部捲動）
zh.diagram: 比例示意圖（不是實際像素大小）
zh.warningFloor: 邊框加內距超過宣告尺寸，內容已降至零；實際邊框盒仍較大。
zh.warningContent: content-box 的宣告值只決定內容；內距與邊框另加到占用尺寸。
zh.zero: 內容尺寸為零，並不代表整個盒子消失。
zh.LENGTH: 原始文字超過 16 字元。
zh.GRAMMAR: 請輸入 ASCII 數字，最多兩位小數；不接受符號、指數或單位。
zh.helpTitle: 為什麼看起來比宣告尺寸更大？
zh.help: content-box：宣告寬高是內容，向外再加內距和邊框。border-box：從宣告尺寸先扣內距與邊框，但內容不能負數；若扣完不足零，實際邊框盒仍會超過宣告值。所有表格以百分之一像素整數精確計算，原生瀏覽器佈局須獨立量測。
zh.help2: 原生盒子為空 div，沒有文字、最小尺寸或 transform。深色實線是邊框，淺綠為內距背景，藍色為內容背景；表格與示意圖標籤不依賴顏色。最大原生占用可達 840×840 px，局部捲動，不縮小。示意圖只等比縮放。
zh.privacy: 只輸入合成數字；無上傳、儲存、URL 狀態、遙測或剪貼簿 API。換語言保留 raw 和狀態，重新載入回預設。不分析其他網站，不處理 margin、百分比、flex/grid 或任意 CSS。

en.title: CSS Box Model Sizing Explorer
en.subtitle: The same ten numbers, two sizing models. Understand declared dimensions and occupied space.
en.hint: Width/height 0–600; padding up to two decimals; borders are integers. Leading zeros allowed; no signs, exponent or units. Maximum 16 raw characters per field.
en.valid: Both results updated from one input snapshot.
en.dirty: Inputs changed. Generate again; old results were removed.
en.defaultExample: Default example: compare space in both sizing modes.
en.native: Native CSS preview (actual size, locally scrollable)
en.warningFloor: Padding plus borders exceed a declared dimension. Content floors at zero; the actual border box is still larger.
en.warningContent: The content-box declaration sizes content only; padding and borders add occupied space.
en.zero: Zero content does not mean the entire box disappears.
en.GRAMMAR: Use ASCII digits with up to two decimals; no signs, exponent or units.
en.RANGE: Number is outside this field's range.
en.helpTitle: Why is the box larger than its declared size?
en.help: content-box: declared dimensions size content, with padding and borders added outside. border-box: subtract padding and borders from the declared size, but content cannot be negative. If they exceed the declared dimension, the actual border box is still larger. Tables use exact hundredth-pixel integers; browser layout requires independent measurement.
en.help2: The native box is an empty div without text, minimum size or transforms. Dark solid lines are borders, pale green is padding background, and blue is content background; tables and schematic labels also identify layers without color. The largest native box is 840×840 px and scrolls locally rather than shrinking. Only the schematic scales uniformly.
en.privacy: Synthetic numeric input only; no upload, storage, URL state, telemetry or Clipboard API. Language switching preserves raw/state; reload restores defaults. No other-site diagnosis, margin, percentage sizing, flex/grid or arbitrary CSS.
